ask: Every job quote gets re-typed three times — once from the email enquiry into our quoting sheet, again into Xero when it's accepted, and again into the job board. Roughly 60 quotes a week. We want the email to land and the rest to happen by itself.
budgetSignal: Said they pay a part-time admin around £900/month mostly to do this, and would rather spend that on fixing it properly.
timeline: Wants it working before their busy season starts in about 10 weeks.
notes: Already on Xero and uses Gmail. The job board is a Google Sheet. Ruth signs off on spend herself.

expected.why: Named repetitive process with volume, a real cost being paid today, owner-level decision maker, a deadline, and tools that all have APIs.
